CustomField.description: Which Work_Item__c field this row maps onto. One metadata type rather than one per field: the lookup shape is identical, and splitting it would mean two classes doing the same thing to two tables that must agree about the same vocabulary. Field (build 08) maps a Work_Item__c field API name to the vendor field that holds it, e.g. Start_Date__c to Jira customfield_10015 - custom field ids differ per Jira site, so they are configuration, never constants.
CustomField.label: Mapping Type
